about: Gustave Doré (1832-1883), Bible engravings first published in La Sainte Bible selon la Vulgate (Tours: Mame, 1866). The engravings are in the public domain worldwide. Images are resized web derivatives (max 900 px) from the Internet Archive set 'Gustave Doré Bible Illustrations - 241 Plates, 1866 First Edition' (https://archive.org/details/dore-bible-illustrations-1866), whose plates are scans from the BnF/Gallica copy of the 1866 edition (credit: Source gallica.bnf.fr / Bibliothèque nationale de France; Gallica asks for that credit and permits free non-commercial reuse), except plates 1-2, from public-domain Wikimedia Commons scans of Doré's English Bible. Plate captions follow the standard English Doré titles; Scripture references were assigned per plate and plates whose scene could not be pinned to a passage were omitted.
